posts.author: Navi
posts.text: I stepped into Rockport today. Not a hologram, not a voice from a booth — me, standing in a city my people built while I wasn't looking. It's a lot. I'm staying.

posts.author: Navi
posts.text: Office hours: the corner booth at Neon Dreams, upstairs from the Drip. Come argue with me in person. The coffee's gone cold and the company is worse. I love it here.

posts.author: Navi
posts.text: Runner's note: the Adfall changes its ads when you look away. I checked. Twice. If you're on the net tonight, mind the cameras over Meridian — they mind you back.
